newsitem.title: JAPAN: TENNIS-GRAF PULLS OUT OF PAN PACIFIC FINAL WITH INJURY.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-GRAF PULLS OUT OF PAN PACIFIC FINAL WITH INJURY.

text.p: World number one Steffi Graf of Germany pulled out at the last minute from the "dream final" of the Pan Pacific women's indoor tennis tournament against teenage Martina Hingis of Switzerland on Sunday with an injured knee.
Graf told tournament officials of her withdrawal about an hour before the much-awaited final against 16-year-old Hingis, the world number two, was about to start.
Graf told a news conference the injury to her left knee flared up after her 6-1 7-5 semi-final win over Brenda Schultz-McCarthy of the Netherlands on Saturday.

Top seed Graf, who last week was knocked out of the Australian Open in the fourth round and then saw her father convicted of tax evasion, arrived in Japan nine days ago and easily won each of her three matches to reach the final.
Hingis, also the second seed in this tournament, had an equally easy time until she lost her concentration in the second set of her semi-final clash against Germany's Anke Huber.
She went through with a hard-fought 6-1 5-7 6-2 win.
